common.initialization: Create a single fresh original encoder/additive-adapter state after seed=20260925; clone E and W (and zero b) to both arms. Bind initial tensor hashes and implementation/env before authorization; do not resume old B0.
common.loss: Per-example mean squared normalized-x0 error over exactly 263*T valid entries; sum three example losses /3. No auxiliary losses, sample/frame weighting, or response loss.
common.optimizer_note: Retain old serialized defaults, including foreach=null and fused=null. Bind same torch/device/backend for both arms and serialize resolved settings; no independent optimizer change.
common.precision: float32; no AMP, gradient clipping, scheduler or early stopping
common.accumulation: zero_grad once per update; three true-length examples, backward(loss/3) each, then optimizer.step exactly once. Even null examples stay in denominator and MDM counts. If a null loss has no trainable graph, skip backward and record zero control-gradient contribution; do not renormalize other losses.
common.training_rng: Use training_schedule.json literally; do not redraw condition/t/noise in hooks or backbone. Equal schedule across arms; all listed examples forwarded once including null. Noise generation is PCG64 keyed by full address SHA256, not torch.randn.
common.selection: final200 only; never choose by D, losses, train or val results

selection: All32 validation sources in original dataset; first8 outputs reused, remaining24 paired/MDM generated. No output-based selection.
method: OriginalU100 with textCFG2.5; all32 head development validation sources, no training or candidate change.
text_baseline: official frozen MDM backbone through strict original-encoder bypass, text CFG2.5; same true-length DDPM/noise protocol, not a published benchmark number
scope: Complete head development matrix; one seed/K1, not formal test. Two simple head baselines32 each reused.
